```plato

    // One tangential relaxation step: every interior vertex moves toward the
    // centroid of its ring, with the component along its own normal removed, so
    // the vertices redistribute over the surface without leaving it. This is the
    // step that makes isotropic remeshing produce even triangles rather than
    // merely correctly-sized ones.
    TangentialRelaxationStep(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology, strength: Number): TriangleMesh3D
    {
        var neighbors = self.VertexNeighborTable(topology);
        var normals = self.VertexNormalVectors;
        var boundary = self.BoundaryVertexFlags(topology);
        return (self.Positions.Count.MapRange(v =>
                    boundary[v]
                        ? self.Positions[v]
                        : self.Positions[v] + TangentialPart(
                            UniformLaplacian(self.Positions, neighbors, v), normals[v]) * strength),
                self.Faces);
    }
```
